result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom navigation bar is visibly broken: the 'Orders' tab renders only a text label with no icon, unlike the other three tabs, leaving an empty gap above it. There are also two smaller inconsistencies: the favorite (heart) buttons on the restaurant cards use different background treatments, and the search placeholder text is low-contrast against the light field.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' tab has no icon while Home, Search and Profile all show an icon above their label. This leaves a blank space above 'Orders' and makes the tab look unfinished/broken and visually unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended Orders icon (e.g. a receipt/bag outline) in the same size, stroke weight and inactive gray color as the other tabs, and verify the icon asset is loading for all tab states.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the ramen card's heart sits directly on the image with no backdrop, while the pizza card's heart has a dark translucent circular scrim. On light imagery the un-scrimmed white heart would be hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background (or a consistent shadow/scrim) to the heart button on every card so it stays legible over any image.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving a contrast ratio likely below the 4.5:1 threshold for body text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g. to a mid-gray around #6B7280) or lighten the field fill so the placeholder and search icon meet WCAG AA contrast.
